title: Feasibility Determination for Subjective Probability Constraints
summary: We consider the problem of determining feasible systems from a finite set of simulated alternatives with respect to probability constraints, where the observations from stochastic simulations are Bernoulli distributed. Most statistically valid procedures for feasibility determination focus on constraints on the means of normally distributed observations.
